payload.text: I read this as implementation - I’ll inspect the scoped Astro, workflow, and landing/navigation files, make the smallest base-path-safe changes, then run the site build.

The subpath check exposed a trailing-slash edge case when the Pages action returns `/repository` without a slash; I normalized that value in Astro config and am rerunning the check with `BASE_URL` actually set.

I read this as implementation - completed and verified GitHub Pages subpath readiness.
